source._build_packages_note: Noble names verified with apt-cache policy on ubuntu:24.04 2026-10-10. builder_image is ubuntu:24.04 (NOT the renderer default gcc:14-bookworm) so the toolchain, headers and sonames are Ubuntu 24.04's: the binary is compiled against exactly the libpq5/libsnmp40t64/libssl3t64 it loads at runtime. Because the builder has no compiler, gcc/libc6-dev/make/binutils are listed here and vendored as build-debs for the --network=none make. autoconf/automake run bootstrap.sh (git checkouts ship no configure); perl runs create/bin/gen_schema.pl for `make dbschema`. -dev set = upstream zabbix-docker build-base/ubuntu minus mysql/sqlite/Go/Java (server-pgsql needs none of them).
source._source_prep_note: Runs ONLINE in the vendor stage (git checkout present): stamps the revision the way upstream's build does (their sed of {ZABBIX_REVISION}, but from source.commit so it is deterministic and needs no .git offline), then generates configure with bootstrap.sh so the vendored tree is configure-ready like a release tarball.
source._build_env_note: upstream zabbix-docker build-pgsql hardening flags, verbatim. PERL_HASH_SEED=0 + PERL_PERTURB_KEYS=0 (2026-10-22, chain 608): `make dbschema` runs create/bin/gen_schema.pl, whose c_append_changelog_tables() prints the changelog_tables[] array with `each(%table_types)`, i.e. in Perl's randomized hash order, so two offline builds of the same tree linked zabbix_server with that array (and its .rela.dyn/.data.rel.ro/build-id) in different orders (scripts/determinism-diff.sh zabbix --chain 608: the ONLY differing file, 141 bytes). A fixed hash seed makes the order the same on every build; the order has no meaning (entries are looked up by object id). Build environment only: the source is not changed.
build_cmds: mkdir -p /opt/zabbix/share/zabbix/database/postgresql && cat database/postgresql/schema.sql database/postgresql/images.sql database/postgresql/data.sql | gzip -9n > /opt/zabbix/share/zabbix/database/postgresql/create.sql.gz && cp COPYING /opt/zabbix/share/zabbix/COPYING
source._build_cmds_note: Mirrors upstream build-pgsql: configure (server; --enable-agent ONLY so zabbix_get/zabbix_sender get built — src/Makefile.am builds them under AGENT — the zabbix_agentd daemon itself is deleted from the install tree), make dbschema (generates the schema C sources + database/postgresql/*.sql from create/src/schema.tmpl), make, make install into the isolated prefix the renderer copies whole. create.sql.gz = schema+images+data exactly as upstream assembles it; gzip -n so the archive carries no name/mtime (bit-for-bit). zabbix_server is copied, never the build tree. --with-libcurl names curl-config explicitly (m4/libcurl.m4 accepts the FILE): the bare flag contains the text 'curl ' and trips gen_dockerfile's offline network lint.
